Imbrium 的原型工作流程

这是一系列工作流程原型，旨在解决我在新手接触 ComfyUI 环境时遇到的两个最大的烦恼和问题：

问题一：ComfyUI 很难看出什么用在哪里、要更改什么、要保留什么以及发生了什么。

  • 的极简和高级工作流程是专门为解决这个问题而设计的。全部典型的输入被明确定义，布局旨在模拟 Web-UI。

问题2：ComfyUI 有太多的自定义节点，每次我尝试开始时，我的进度都会因混乱和损坏的依赖关系而受到阻碍。

  • 的极简工作流程旨在利用尽可能多的 ComfyCore 节点，减少可用性和质量的某些方面，但比传统的“即插即用”更接近“即插即用”高级工作流程。

原型包括 2 个工作流程：

  1. 最小 -此工作流程旨在使用尽可能多的 ComfyCore 节点，这意味着更少的依赖性、更少的错误以及更少的新用户困惑。

    • 现在需要以下自定义节点：

      • rgtri-舒适：这在前端使用 GetNode 和 SetNode 来清理 UI。我们还利用了 Power Lora Loader。

  2. [本周晚些时候即将推出，测试中]高级- 此工作流程旨在利用强大的自定义节点来获取最好的结果可能同时仍然利用干净的用户界面。该工作流程允许大量定制，使用数学节点自动计算，真实去采样和重采样（与最小工作流程相比），以及先进采样器方法的利用。 UI 包括组旁路以启用/禁用重采样、启用/禁用、升级以及启用/禁用高级功能。

o.en:
Imbrium's Prototype Workflows

This is a prototype series of workflows intended to solve my two biggest annoyances and issues with onboarding somebody new to the ComfyUI landscape:

ISSUE 1:ComfyUI is difficult to see what is used where, what to change, what to keep in place, and what is going on.

  • TheMINIMALandADVANCEDworkflows are designed specifically to solve this problem. Alltypicalinputs are clearly defined and the layout is meant to emulate a web-UI.

ISSUE 2:ComfyUI has too many custom nodes and every time I try to get started my progress gets crippled with confusing and broken dependencies.

  • TheMINIMALworkflow is designed to leverage as many ComfyCore nodes as possible, reducing some aspects of usability and quality but making much closer to "plug and play" than theADVANCEDworkflow.

The prototypes include 2 Workflows:

  1. MINIMAL -This workflow is designed to use as much ComfyCore nodes as possible, meaning less dependencies, less errors, and less new-user confusion.

    • Right now the following Custom Nodes are needed:

      • rgthree-comfy:this is used on the frontend for GetNode and SetNode to clean up the UI. We also leverage the Power Lora Loader there.

  2. [COMING LATER THIS WEEK, IN TESTING]ADVANCED- This workflow is intended to leverage strong custom nodes to get thebest resultspossible while still leveraging a clean UI. This workflow allows for vast customization, automatic calculation with math nodes,truedesampling and resampling (compared to the MINIMAL workflow), as well as utilization of advanced sampler methodologies. The UI includes group bypassing to enable/disable the resampling, enable/disable, the upscaling, and enable/disable advanced functionalities.
